No hay registro propio. Un administrador de nuestro equipo crea tu cuenta cuando nos contactas. Con ese usuario ingresas con el botón Ingresar.
¿Es para reservar una habitación o una mesa?
No. Mercado Patagónico es para quienes compran y abastecen: hoteles, restaurantes, cafés y caterings que necesitan proveerse de productos. Los pedidos se hacen dentro de la plataforma.
Productos que en el sur son difíciles de conseguir con el proveedor de siempre. El catálogo se ve al ingresar. No incluye fruta ni verdura.

en.queTitle: What Santiago has, now in the south
en.que1: Mercado Patagónico supplies food to the HORECA channel: hotels, restaurants, cafés and catering in Magallanes. We bring to the south products that suppliers in the area do not carry and that until now could only be found in Santiago.
en.que2: To use the platform, you log in with the user our team creates for you. Inside, you see the catalog and place your orders.
steps: Tell us about your business in a short form.
An administrator on our team creates your user. There is no self-registration.
You log in to the platform
With your user, you see the catalog and place your orders inside the platform.
Your order arrives at your business.

For hotels, restaurants, cafés and catering
faq: HORECA businesses: hotels, restaurants, cafés and catering. Contact us and we will review your case.
How do I get my account?
There is no self-registration. An administrator on our team creates your account when you contact us. With that user, you log in with the Log in button.
Is this for booking a room or a table?
No. Mercado Patagónico is for those who buy and stock up: hotels, restaurants, cafés and caterers that need to source products. Orders are placed inside the platform.
Products that are hard to find in the south from your usual supplier. The catalog is visible after logging in. It does not include fruit or vegetables.
